entities.name: Uncle Istvan
entities.description: An old hermit of the Eln Forest on Terisiare, driven insane by solitude and murderous to intruders, wielding a bloodied axe.

entities.name: Eln Forest
entities.description: Forest on Terisiare where Istvan lived alone.

events.summary: Uncle Istvan, driven insane by solitude, became murderous to any intruders in the Eln Forest.
events.quote: Eventually, the solitude drove him insane, and he became murderous to any intruders.

relations.note: He lived alone in the forest.
relations.quote: Istvan was an old hermit, living alone in the Eln Forest.
